title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README and contributor guidance to understand the REST API scope, Neo4j-backed knowledge base model, and safety constraints.

title: Application Bootstrap
description: Follow the Spring Boot entry point and configuration resources that initialize the service and profiles.

title: Schema and Knowledge Base API
description: Inspect the controller, registry service, schema parser, and repositories that enforce immutable schema identity and active schema rules.

title: Document Ingestion Pipeline
description: Trace upload, storage, parsing, chunking, embedding, and graph extraction from the document controller into service and graph components.

title: Query Flow
description: Review Cypher generation, validation, and execution, including read-only safeguards and query controller endpoints.

title: Verification Coverage
description: Finish with the integration and focused service tests that exercise the end-to-end flow and cleanup behavior.
